name: Negotiate a raise
taskTemplate: Book a compensation review before {month} — a ${amount}/mo raise gets you to your True Number {years} years sooner

name: Upskill into a higher-paying role
taskTemplate: Pick one certification in your field and block {hours} hrs/week — targets +${amount}/mo within {ramp} months

name: Freelance consulting
taskTemplate: Land one freelance client at {hours} hrs/week — ${amount}/mo closes {impact} of your gap
notes: Check employment contract for moonlighting clauses

name: Tutoring / coaching
taskTemplate: List yourself as a tutor for {hours} hrs/week — about ${amount}/mo

name: Rideshare or delivery driving
taskTemplate: Try weekend driving for one month at {hours} hrs/week — about ${amount}/mo before vehicle costs
notes: Scale by city wageIndex; net of fuel/wear is lower

name: Skilled trade side work
taskTemplate: Take {hours} hrs/week of side jobs in {city} — about ${amount}/mo

name: Rent out a spare room
taskTemplate: Furnish and list your spare room — about ${amount}/mo that keeps paying after you stop working, cutting your True Number by ${impact}

name: Build a legal basement suite
taskTemplate: Get a quote for a legal suite in {city} — about ${amount}/mo for life, cutting your True Number by ${impact}

name: Occasional short-term rental
taskTemplate: Host your home while you travel — about ${amount}/mo on average
notes: Many cities restrict short-term rentals; verify bylaws

name: Online shop / digital products
taskTemplate: Launch one product online with {hours} hrs/week — a ${amount}/mo target after {ramp} months

name: Launch a small business
taskTemplate: Write a one-page business plan and test demand before committing ${startup}
notes: Highest variance; pairs with ambitious investment approach

name: Income-focused investment portfolio
taskTemplate: Direct new savings toward income-producing investments — every $100k invested adds about ${amount}/mo for life. Review with your advisor.
notes: Monthly = derivedRate × capital ÷ 12; keep wording general (no product picks)
